svg.title: Drive Venture supervised-driving requirements by state
svg.desc: A state tile map. Michigan is bright yellow as currently supported. Other states with exactly 50 supervised hours are muted yellow. Other hour requirements are gray. A green inner border marks states requiring a detailed driving log. Research verified August 16, 2026.
